notes: lockup_years is the hard, contractual period during which capital cannot be withdrawn at all.
exit_load_months is a soft cost window: withdrawal is permitted but a fee applies.
min_recommended_years is a suitability floor driven by the product's volatility, not a contractual term.
age_locked products unlock at an age rather than after a fixed number of years.

products.name: Open-ended Large Cap Equity Fund
products.basis: SEBI open-ended scheme; redeemable on any business day.

products.name: Open-ended Flexi Cap Equity Fund
products.basis: SEBI open-ended scheme; redeemable on any business day.

products.name: Open-ended Mid Cap Equity Fund
products.basis: SEBI open-ended scheme; drawdown profile needs a long runway.

products.name: Open-ended Small Cap Equity Fund
products.basis: SEBI open-ended scheme; deepest drawdowns of the equity set.

products.name: Nifty 50 Index Fund
products.basis: Passive open-ended scheme, typically no exit load.

products.name: ELSS (Equity Linked Savings Scheme)
products.basis: Statutory 3-year lock-in per instalment under Section 80C.

products.name: Aggressive Hybrid Fund
products.basis: SEBI open-ended scheme, 65-80% equity.

products.name: Balanced Advantage Fund
products.basis: Dynamic equity allocation dampens the drawdown.

products.name: Corporate Bond Fund
products.basis: Open-ended debt scheme, predominantly AA+ and above.

products.name: Short Duration Debt Fund
products.basis: Macaulay duration 1-3 years.

products.name: Gilt Fund
products.basis: No credit risk but material duration risk.

products.name: Liquid Fund
products.basis: Graded exit load for redemptions within 7 days.

products.name: Arbitrage Fund
products.basis: Cash-futures arbitrage with equity taxation.

products.name: Gold ETF / Gold Fund of Funds
products.basis: Exchange traded or open-ended FoF.

products.name: Fixed Maturity Plan (3-year)
products.basis: Close-ended; listed but effectively illiquid until maturity.

products.name: Public Provident Fund
products.basis: 15-year maturity; partial withdrawal only from year 7.

products.name: National Savings Certificate (VIII Issue)
products.basis: 5-year statutory term.

products.name: Senior Citizens' Savings Scheme
products.basis: 5-year term; premature closure carries a penalty. Age 60+ only.

products.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
products.basis: Matures 21 years from opening; partial withdrawal at girl's age 18.

products.name: 5-year Tax Saving Fixed Deposit
products.basis: No premature withdrawal permitted under Section 80C.

products.name: Bank Fixed Deposit (non-tax-saving)
products.basis: Breakable with a 0.5-1.0% rate penalty.

products.name: Sovereign Gold Bond
products.basis: 8-year maturity; RBI buyback from year 5. Exchange liquidity is thin.

products.name: Unit Linked Insurance Plan
products.basis: IRDAI-mandated 5-year lock-in; front-loaded charges.

products.name: NPS Tier I
products.basis: Locked until age 60; 40% must be annuitised at exit.

products.name: NPS Tier II
products.basis: Withdrawable at will for non-government subscribers.

products.name: EPF / Voluntary Provident Fund
products.basis: Locked until 58 apart from specified partial-withdrawal grounds.
